# Original audio test fixtures

`calibration.mp3` and `calibration.ogg` contain eight seconds of original damped percussion pulses at 120 BPM, first onset 0.15 seconds. They test real file parsing, browser codec decoding and transport. They are **not folk-music recordings** and are never installed in the production music library.

Source: `scripts/create-test-audio.py`. Encoded locally with soundfile 0.14.0 / libsndfile; the encoder is an optional authoring tool, not a runtime dependency. WAV fixtures are generated by `test/helpers/audio.ts`. No third-party performance, sample, composition or downloaded audio is included. These original fixtures are dedicated to CC0-1.0: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/ .
